Human review is needed to determine which option groups are mutually exclusive and how to compute the total.

The group 'CHEM/LIFS/ Science 1000-level course (1 course from the specified course PHYS list)' has a garbled header; the intended meaning is likely 'CHEM/LIFS/Physics 1000-level course (1 course from the specified list)', but the exact phrasing is unclear from the PDF layout.

In the Required Course(s) group on page 2, the course 'LANG 4034 Technical Communication Il for Mechanical and Aerospace' appears to have a typo ('Il' instead of 'II', 'Enaineerina' fragment), but the course code and credits are clear.

The note for MECH 3300/3420/3520/3710 on page 2 is split across lines: 'MECH Note: MECH 3300 OR MECH 3420 OR MECH 3520 OR MECH 3\n3710' — this was interpreted as a note for the group, but it may instead be a note for a specific course selection. However, no single course is directly associated with this note in the table, so it was safely attached to the group.

The course MECH 3520 appears with '**' in the name on page 2, but the remarks on page 4 indicate it was last offered in 2019-20 and deleted. It is still listed as a valid course in the requirements, so it is included as-is.

The course COMP 1022P and MATH 1012 are marked with '**' and noted as deleted in remarks on page 4, but they are still part of the OR conditions in the fundamental courses. They are retained in the extraction as they are formally part of the requirement logic.

total_required_credits (55.0) is a computed value: the sum of the required_credits of all groups in this file. The PDF does not state a single overall minimum total for this program, so this figure is derived by summation and may double-count where optional tracks/options are listed as separate groups.
